# World Models

> Learned world models and simulators used for planning, policy evaluation and data generation.  
> Layer: L6 · 70 entries · [overview](../README.md#world-model) · [survey](../SURVEY.md)

**Legend:** 🟢 open · 🟡 partial · 🔵 api · ⚪ closed. Hover a name for the full paper title. Newest first within each year.

**2026**

- ⚪ [**Spatial Memory Intelligence**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02521 "Spatial Memory Intelligence: Endowing World Models with Understanding-Driven Long-Term Memory") · 2026-10 — Uses a multimodal understanding model to manage long-range spatial memory in long-video world models through four operations: spatial clustering, within-cluster sparsification, action-aware retrieval and reliability-aware filtering. _Note: Repository lists training and evaluation code as coming soon (checked 2026-10-06)._ [project](https://spatial-memory-intelligence.github.io/)
- ⚪ [**RIWANav**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08640 "RIWANav: Recursive World-Action Models with Self-Improvement for Urban Navigation") · 2026-10 — Post-training loop that co-adapts an action-conditioned world model and a navigation policy: the world model scores policy actions by imagined outcomes for GRPO, and the improved policy builds a grounded self-curriculum to refresh the world model.
- ⚪ [**DeltaWorld**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.02691 "DeltaWorld: Physically Consistent Interactive World Simulators via Action-Conditioned Latent Increment Learning") · 2026-10 — Interactive world simulator for manipulation that predicts action-induced latent changes added to the current state, rather than the whole next state, with measures against object interpenetration and excessive deformation over long horizons.
- 🟢 [**RoboCoach**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39685 "RoboCoach: World Models as Active Coaches for Compositional Robot Skills") · 2026-09 — Route-Imagine-Diagnose-Improve loop that runs reusable skill experts inside a shared action-conditioned world model (CoachWorld), uses a progress judge to find the first failing subtask, and targets new demonstrations and adapter updates there; tested on Franka and AgileX. [code](https://github.com/RoboCoach-AI/CoachWorld) · [project](https://robocoach-ai.github.io/) · [weights](https://huggingface.co/JEdward/CoachWorld)
- ⚪ [**Planning Limits of Latent World Models**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39235 "The Planning Limits of Latent World Models") · 2026-09 — Shows that action-conditioned predictors on frozen visual backbones (V-JEPA 2, DINOv2 and others) rank actions reliably only for goals within about their imagined horizon, even with perfect prediction; within that range, reranking VLA proposals improves success.
- 🟢 [**OpenWAM**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.07398 "OpenWAM: An Open, Modular Exploration Towards Systematic World-Action Model Pretraining") · 2026-09 — Open modular research stack for world-action model pretraining with controlled studies of what to inherit from video priors and how world and action learning interact; its OpenWAM-α model is pretrained on about 6,400 hours of egocentric human and robot data. [code](https://github.com/OpenWAM-Official/OpenWAM) · [project](https://openwam-official.github.io/) · [weights](https://huggingface.co/OpenWAM/OpenWAM-Alpha-Pretrain-Foundation-Model)
- ⚪ [**InternW0-Δ**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.31394 "InternW0-Δ: A World Action Model Bridging Predictive Dynamics and Actions with 20K+ Hours of Open Data") · 2026-09 · Shanghai AI Laboratory — World action model that combines a pretrained video expert and an action expert under frozen-VLM guidance, distills 4D geometry and motion priors during training, and pretrains on a 20K+ hour open corpus of robot, UMI and egocentric human data. _Note: Authors state code, weights and processed data will be open-sourced._ [project](https://internrobotics.github.io/InternW0-Delta/)
- ⚪ [**GE-Act 2.0**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.05588 "GE-Act 2.0: Pretraining and Scaling a World-Action Model for Robotic Manipulation") · 2026-09 · AgiBot — World-action model trained from scratch on manipulation data (control-oriented autoencoder, single-step visual planner, inverse dynamics model); scaling co-training data from 300 to 30,000 hours raised zero-shot success from 17.1% to 44.1% on its G1-OP evaluation. _Note: Successor to GE-Act in Genie Envisioner; first-party results; no code or weights found._ [project](https://ge-act-v2.github.io/)

- ⚪ [**WorldGym**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2506.00613 "WorldGym: World Model as An Environment for Policy Evaluation") · 2025-05 — Autoregressive action-conditioned video model used as an evaluation environment: policies run Monte Carlo rollouts from a single real start frame with a VLM providing rewards, and success rates correlate with real-world results. [project](https://world-model-eval.github.io/)
- 🟡 [**WorldEval**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.19017 "WorldEval: World Model as Real-World Robot Policies Evaluator") · 2025-05 · Midea Group, East China Normal University — Turns a video generation model into a latent-action-following world simulator (Policy2Vec) and builds an automated pipeline that ranks real-robot policies and checkpoints and flags dangerous actions, correlating with real-world performance. _Note: Code and evaluated policy weights released; world-model weights not found._ [code](https://github.com/liyaxuanliyaxuan/Worldeval) · [project](https://worldeval.github.io/)
- 🟢 [**EWMBench**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.09694 "EWMBench: Evaluating Scene, Motion, and Semantic Quality in Embodied World Models") · 2025-05 · AgiBot — Embodied World Model Benchmark that scores text-to-video world models on visual scene consistency, motion correctness and semantic alignment using a curated robot-manipulation dataset and a multi-dimensional evaluation toolkit. [code](https://github.com/AgibotTech/EWMBench)
- 🟢 [**EnerVerse-AC**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.09723 "EnerVerse-AC: Envisioning Embodied Environments with Action Condition") · 2025-05 · AgiBot — Action-conditioned multi-view world model with multi-level action conditioning and ray-map encoding, trained with failure trajectories; serves both as a data engine that augments demonstrations and as an evaluator for policy testing. [code](https://github.com/AgibotTech/EnerVerse-AC) · [project](https://annaj2178.github.io/EnerverseAC.github.io/) · [weights](https://huggingface.co/agibot-world/EnerVerse-AC)
- 🟢 [**DreamGen (GR00T-Dreams)**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.12705 "DreamGen: Unlocking Generalization in Robot Learning through Video World Models") · 2025-05 · NVIDIA — Four-stage pipeline that adapts image-to-video world models to a target robot, generates synthetic "neural trajectories", labels them with latent-action or inverse-dynamics models and trains policies; a humanoid learned 22 new behaviors from single-task teleop data. [code](https://github.com/NVIDIA/GR00T-Dreams) · [project](https://research.nvidia.com/labs/gear/dreamgen/)
- 🟢 [**Unified World Models (UWM)**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.02792 "Unified World Models: Coupling Video and Action Diffusion for Pretraining on Large Robotic Datasets") · 2025-04 · University of Washington, Toyota Research Institute — Transformer coupling action and video diffusion with independent timesteps, so one model acts as policy, forward or inverse dynamics model or video generator and can pretrain on both robot trajectories and action-free video. [code](https://github.com/WEIRDLabUW/unified-world-model) · [project](https://weirdlabuw.github.io/uwm/)
- 🟢 [**TesserAct**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.20995 "TesserAct: Learning 4D Embodied World Models") · 2025-04 · UMass Amherst — 4D embodied world model that fine-tunes a video generator to predict RGB, depth and normal frames, converts them into temporally coherent 4D scenes, and uses them to learn inverse dynamics that beat prior video-based world models for policy learning. [code](https://github.com/UMass-Embodied-AGI/TesserAct) · [project](https://tesseractworld.github.io/) · [weights](https://huggingface.co/anyeZHY/tesseract)
- 🟢 [**Cosmos-Transfer1**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.14492 "Cosmos-Transfer1: Conditional World Generation with Adaptive Multimodal Control") · 2025-03 · NVIDIA — Conditional world-generation model driven by spatially weighted control inputs (segmentation, depth, edges) for world-to-world transfer, used for robotics sim2real and driving data enrichment. [code](https://github.com/nvidia-cosmos/cosmos-transfer1)
- 🟢 [**Unified Video Action Model (UVA)**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.00200 "Unified Video Action Model") · 2025-02 · Stanford University — Learns a joint video-action latent with decoupled lightweight diffusion heads, so actions can be decoded quickly without generating video; masking lets one model serve as policy, forward or inverse dynamics model and video predictor. [code](https://github.com/ShuangLI59/unified_video_action) · [project](https://unified-video-action-model.github.io/)
- 🟢 [**NVIDIA Cosmos**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2501.03575 "Cosmos World Foundation Model Platform for Physical AI") · 2025-01 · NVIDIA — Open platform of world foundation models for physical AI: video curation pipeline, video tokenizers, pretrained diffusion and autoregressive world models and post-training examples; later Predict2.5/Transfer2.5 target synthetic data, policy evaluation and sim2real. _Note: Cosmos-Predict2.5 and Cosmos-Transfer2.5 are described in arXiv 2511.00062 (Oct 2025)._ [code](https://github.com/nvidia-cosmos/cosmos-predict1) · [project](https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/ai/cosmos/) · [weights](https://huggingface.co/nvidia/Cosmos-Predict1-7B-Video2World)
- ⚪ [**EnerVerse**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2501.01895 "EnerVerse: Envisioning Embodied Future Space for Robotics Manipulation") · 2025-01 · AgiBot — Generative robotics model that predicts future multi-view embodied space with chunk-wise autoregressive video diffusion and sparse memory, couples it with a 4D Gaussian-splatting data engine, and decodes actions through a policy head. [project](https://sites.google.com/view/enerverse)

**2024**

- 🟢 [**Video Prediction Policy (VPP)**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2412.14803 "Video Prediction Policy: A Generalist Robot Policy with Predictive Visual Representations") · 2024-12 · Tsinghua University, Robotera — Fine-tunes a video diffusion model on robot and human manipulation video and learns an implicit inverse dynamics policy conditioned on its predicted future representations; reports +18.6% on CALVIN ABC-D and +31.6% on real dexterous tasks. [code](https://github.com/roboterax/video-prediction-policy) · [project](https://video-prediction-policy.github.io/) · [weights](https://huggingface.co/yjguo/svd-robot)
- 🟢 [**Navigation World Models (NWM)**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2412.03572 "Navigation World Models") · 2024-12 · Meta FAIR, New York University, UC Berkeley — 1B-parameter conditional diffusion transformer trained on egocentric human and robot videos that predicts future views from past observations and navigation actions; plans by simulating and ranking trajectories and can add constraints at planning time. _Note: Weights are gated on Hugging Face (manual approval)._ [code](https://github.com/facebookresearch/nwm) · [project](https://www.amirbar.net/nwm/) · [weights](https://huggingface.co/facebook/nwm)
- ⚪ [**Genie 2**](https://deepmind.google/blog/genie-2-a-large-scale-foundation-world-model/) · 2024-12 · Google DeepMind — Large-scale foundation world model that generates action-controllable, playable 3D environments from a single prompt image with up to a minute of consistency and long-horizon memory; used to test the SIMA instruction-following agent.
- 🟢 [**DINO-WM**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2411.04983 "DINO-WM: World Models on Pre-trained Visual Features enable Zero-shot Planning") · 2024-11 · New York University, Meta FAIR — World model that predicts future DINOv2 patch features from offline trajectories instead of reconstructing pixels, enabling task-agnostic zero-shot planning toward goal images by optimizing action sequences in maze, pushing and particle tasks. [code](https://github.com/gaoyuezhou/dino_wm) · [project](https://dino-wm.github.io/)
- 🟡 [**1X World Model**](https://www.1x.tech/discover/1x-world-model) · 2024-09 · 1X Technologies — Learned simulator trained on thousands of hours of EVE humanoid data that predicts future observations from action sequences for reproducible policy evaluation; 1X released 100+ hours of tokenized video and baselines for its 1X World Model Challenge. _Note: 1X's production world model is closed; the dataset and baseline models are public._ [code](https://github.com/1x-technologies/1xgpt) · [data](https://huggingface.co/datasets/1x-technologies/world_model_tokenized_data)
- 🟢 [**IRASim**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2406.14540 "IRASim: A Fine-Grained World Model for Robot Manipulation") · 2024-06 · ByteDance Research — Action-conditioned video diffusion transformer with frame-level action conditioning that renders fine-grained robot-object interaction; policy evaluations inside it correlate with a ground-truth simulator, and model-based planning with it improves Push-T results. _Note: arXiv v1 was titled "IRASim: Learning Interactive Real-Robot Action Simulators"._ [code](https://github.com/bytedance/IRASim) · [project](https://gen-irasim.github.io/)
- ⚪ [**Genie**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.15391 "Genie: Generative Interactive Environments") · 2024-02 · Google DeepMind — 11B foundation world model trained without action labels on internet videos (video tokenizer, autoregressive dynamics model and latent action model) that generates action-controllable worlds; its latent actions can help agents imitate unseen videos. [project](https://sites.google.com/view/genie-2024/)

**2023**

- 🟡 [**Video Language Planning (VLP)**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2310.10625 "Video Language Planning") · 2023-10 — Tree search over generated video and language plans, using VLMs as policies and value functions and text-to-video models as dynamics models; plans are executed via goal-conditioned policies on each generated frame. _Note: Released code scope (models/weights) not verified._ [code](https://github.com/video-language-planning/vlp_code) · [project](https://video-language-planning.github.io/)
- ⚪ [**UniSim**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2310.06114 "Learning Interactive Real-World Simulators") · 2023-10 · UC Berkeley, Google DeepMind, MIT — Learned universal simulator that renders the visual outcome of high-level language actions and low-level controls by orchestrating diverse datasets; used to train vision-language planners and RL policies purely in simulation that transfer zero-shot to real robots. [project](https://universal-simulator.github.io/unisim/)
- ⚪ [**UniPi**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2302.00111 "Learning Universal Policies via Text-Guided Video Generation") · 2023-01 · MIT, Google DeepMind — Casts decision making as text-conditioned video generation: a video model synthesizes a plan as future frames and an inverse dynamics model extracts actions, enabling combinatorial generalization to new goals and knowledge transfer from internet video. [project](https://universal-policy.github.io/unipi/)

**2022**

- 🟢 [**DayDreamer**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2206.14176 "DayDreamer: World Models for Physical Robot Learning") · 2022-06 · UC Berkeley — Applies Dreamer world-model RL directly on four physical robots without simulators: a quadruped learns to stand up and walk in about an hour, and robot arms learn pick-and-place from camera images and sparse rewards. [code](https://github.com/danijar/daydreamer) · [project](https://danijar.com/daydreamer/)
